SUNVALE COUNTY WATER DEPARTMENT
1200 Lakeview Blvd, Sunvale, FL 32801

NOVEMBER 3, 2026

FINAL NOTICE - PAST DUE BALANCE

Account Number: 448-20391-7
Service Address: 55 Palm Crest Dr

Dear Customer,

Our records show that your account has a past due balance of $86.42. If payment is not received by November 24, 2026, your water service may be disconnected without further notice. A reconnection fee of $35.00 will apply.

You may pay online at sunvalewater.example, by phone at (555) 010-2233, or in person at our office Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. If you are experiencing financial hardship, you may qualify for a payment arrangement. Please contact Customer Service before the due date.

Sincerely,
Billing Department
